digest.component_or_area: llm model selection and fallback handling
propositions: A class with an unreachable or throttled primary model should fall back to an inline fallback chain rather than failing the gate outright.
FallbackModel construction must honor the endpoint on each fallback entry, building each through the same provider path as the primary.

The fallback_on predicate must be narrowed to errors where switching providers helps (RETRY_NOW, WAIT_AND_RETRY, CHANGE_PROVIDER_OR_MODEL), not generic exceptions, and must be derived from failure.py's _RETRYABLE frozenset to avoid taxonomy drift.

Capabilities and tool guards must be computed from the conservative intersection of all candidates before the FallbackModel wrapper exists, so a chain withdraws a capability if any candidate lacks it.
Provider provenance must record both the ordered candidate list and the ran_model from ModelResponse, not from FallbackModel.model_name, to correctly attest which model actually answered.

All fallback sub-models must be entered and exited together in a single async context manager, with rebar-created transports registered exactly once on ProviderSession._closeables and closed precisely once.
